info.title: HuggingFace Inference API (yorishiro kami spec)
info.description: Hand-authored OpenAPI 3 spec for the HuggingFace Inference API. Separate kami from `huggingface.co` (Hub) — Inference is a different service that runs model forward passes. Reference: https://huggingface.co/docs/api-inference/index

post.summary: Run a feature-extraction (embedding) pipeline against a model
post.description: POST text to the configured model and receive its hidden-state vector representation. Used by mst-projector embedders. The API key is supplied via Authorization: Bearer <key> by the caller and is NOT part of this lexicon — yorishiri never store credentials.

inputs.description: Text to embed (single string or batched). Phase 1: single only.

wait_for_model.description: Wait for cold-start instead of returning 503.

200.description: Feature vector(s) — typically a 2-D array of floats.

schema.description: number[][] (or number[]) depending on model output shape.
